title: Physics in Rust: Genex Physics crates, debris, an explosion and a wrecking ball, drawn per body
note: Keyed Genex Physics bodies spawned in on_reset, pushed by area_push and impulses in on_update, drawn per key under frame.id; one probe per mechanic.
intent: Bodies that fall, are knocked down and blow up are Genex Physics bodies in sim.physics (genex::phys), never a hand-made solver or raw Rapier. Spawn the level in on_reset (every seed starts empty), each body under its own key: physics.spawn(&BodyDesc::new(key, BodyType::Fixed/Dynamic/Kinematic, phys::pose(at, rot), vec![ColliderDesc::new(..)])) with phys::cuboid or phys::ball and mass; a kinematic crane moved by physics.set_next_kinematic_pose; a ball on a JointType::Rope via physics.add_joint. Past 512 bodies raise limits with game.physics_world. The runtime steps once per tick after on_update: never step it. A blast: physics.area_push (physics.overlap counts what it reached); a bomb with events: true goes off on a ContactBegin in physics.events(). A shot: physics.ray, ccd: true only on what flies. Draw each body in on_draw under frame.id(key). Probe each mechanic: "pile" (toppled crates), "blast" (bombs left, blasts, pushed), "wrecking-ball" (on its rope, swung low), "shots"; awake bodies are probe_volatile. Saves: a section of physics.export_row rows (docs/api/physics.md).
port: One facet owns the level's bodies, their update and their probes; a facet that adds a mechanic keeps its own handles in World and moves only its own bodies.

evidence.note: sim.physics is Genex Physics (genex::phys) stepped once per tick after on_update: keyed bodies, colliders, impulses and area_push, events, queries, joints, drawing under frame.id, budgets, save rows from export_row, and raw Rapier deprecated.
Name everything that moves on its own with frame.id(key) so TAA matches it to its last frame.
Physics: keyed Genex Physics bodies in sim.physics, drawn under their own frame.id, saved in a section, one probe per mechanic.
